title: I can’t believe I waited so long to finally see caroline at @mcctheat...
transcript: Seeing Chloë Grace Moretz play a mother in an off Broadway show broke my brain a little bit, because the last time I saw her on stage, 17 years old. But that was over a decade ago. And now she's playing a young mom who will do anything for her daughter, Caroline. Caroline is a new play at MCC About family, identity, and second chances. Chloë plays Maddie, a woman with a very complicated past. She's dealt with addiction, made a lot of mistakes, and has experienced so much pain. But ever since she had her daughter, she's fought every single day to Do better. Caroline is trans and Maddie will do anything to protect her, including going to her estranged parents and asking for help. I deeply love this show and this cast, but what makes Caroline so important is that at a time where trans people are being attacked and politicized Caroline reminds us that trans kids are just kids Caroline's identity is never a debate, she just is who she is. She's a little girl who wants a Nintendo Switch, who teases her mom about her music and loves to wear Lilo & stitch just like every other kid Caroline is tender and funny and so timely and is playing at MCC Theater until November 16. Go and see it.
